chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from more than one of our companions, from Abī Jaʿfar and Abī ʿAbdillāh عليهما السلام:

Regarding the apostate: he is asked to repent; if he repents, otherwise he is killed. And the woman, when she apostasizes, is asked to repent; if she repents, she returns, otherwise she is kept permanently in prison and hardship is imposed upon her in her confinement.

key_terms.ارْتَدَّتْ: she apostasized or turned back from Islam
key_terms.اسْتُتِيبَتْ: she is asked to repent and return
key_terms.الْمُرْتَدِّ: the male apostate, one who has turned back from Islam
key_terms.خُلِّدَتِ السِّجْنَ: she is kept in prison permanently
key_terms.يُسْتَتَابُ: he is asked to repent and return

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a male or female apostate in this hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the male apostate and the female apostate. It states that repentance is first sought from both, and if the woman does not return, she is imprisoned continuously and restricted in her confinement.
